verdict.rationale: Baseten's agent-setup docs say users can install the Baseten skill and MCP servers so a coding agent can manage the Baseten workspace and search the docs. A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented at that page. The evidence is a single brief mention, though, with little detail on how it works. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools/capabilities, setup and authentication steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
